data.name: Sync.E2e.Acknowledge
data.value: I understand that if I forget this passphrase, this vault's secrets cannot be recovered.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.ChangePassphrase.Text
data.value: Changes the passphrase of {0}. Its secrets and other devices are not affected; use the new passphrase from now on.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.Create.Text
data.value: A new vault, with its own passphrase and keys. It is shown by its id until you name it from its settings.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.Delete.Text
data.value: This deletes {0} and its secrets on every device, and its keys, so they can never be decrypted. It cannot be undone.

data.name: Sync.E2e.NoRecoveryWarning
data.value: There is no passphrase recovery. If you forget a vault's passphrase, nobody can decrypt its secrets, including us.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Offline
data.value: You're offline. Vaults can be unlocked and locked, but passphrases can't be set or changed, and vaults can't be created or deleted, until you sign in online.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Text
data.value: Your secrets are encrypted on this device, with keys only you hold, before they are synced. Each vault has its own passphrase.

data.name: Sync.Storage.Location.Text
data.value: Where your vaults are kept on this device. Sync pauses while they are moved.
